environment.description: Go binary deployed as a container on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a public DNS record. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container's port 8080. No authentication middleware is configured. The /upload endpoint is publicly accessible. Uploaded files persist on an EFS mount at /tmp/uploads and are served back via /files/ path with auto-detected content types, enabling stored XSS via SVG/HTML uploads or malware distribution.
